Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Join activities to assays on assay_id, to target_dictionary on tid, to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and to compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to target chembl_id 'CHEMBL1909490', standard_type 'IC50', standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to first 1000 rows.
